title: 1:1 prep - Maya -> Sam
body:
Quick context: Sam switched to the kv-cache optimization work last sprint and picked up the cache eviction debug. Has been shipping a lot but I think they're nearing burnout. Meeting length: 30m. Goals: sync on unblockers, align on priorities for next two weeks, surface career/craft questions, agree on 2 actions.

Agenda (30m):
- 0-5m: personal check-in (how are you, load, any PTO coming up?)
- 5-12m: status on kv-cache regression (what's fixed, what's flaky, any CI signals?)
- 12-20m: roadmap alignment (pairing with infra on load tests, plan for canary)
- 20-27m: career/growth (mentorship, project preferences, next stretch area)
- 27-30m: recap + action items

Notes to self / talking points:
- Praise: call out the quick turnaround on the PR that reduced mem pressure (PR #421). Concrete: "Nice work getting that in and adding the perf test."
- Ask for rough numbers: what are current evictions/day, tail-p90 latency since fix? If unknown, ask where to find metric dashboards.
- Blocker hyp: CI flaky tests are related to seq len edge case — volunteer infra pairing to add deterministic replay? Offer time from me or SRE.
- Prioritization: emphasize shipping stable canary over adding new features. If they push back, discuss tradeoffs (quality vs roadmap).
- Career: Sam mentioned wanting more system-design exposure. Offer to set up 1 design review + shadow on compile/kernel selection work. Suggest they lead a small post-mortem doc.
- Support/burnout: explicitly ask about workload and task sizing. Propose splitting large bug into 3 smaller tickets and identify one cleanup that can be deprioritized.

Possible asks I might make of Sam:
- Finish reprod script for flaky test by EOD Wed (ticket RED-812).
- Draft postmortem bullet list for kv-cache regression by next 1:1.
- Identify one low-effort test or cleanup to hand off to intern/rotating engineer.

Action items to propose (for meeting):
- Sam: repro script + short notes in ticket (RED-812) — due Wed 2026-03-06.
- Me (Maya): book 2h pairing slot with infra (Ben/Sloane) and add to Sam's calendar by Fri.
- Sam: outline 1-page postmortem bullets by next 1:1.

Follow-ups / reminders after the 1:1:
- If Sam is overloaded, shift one non-critical task off their board and notify PL.
- Add Sam to compile/kernel selection review on 2026-03-10 (tentative).
- Checkback on CI flakiness metrics in dashboard (set a metric watch for p95 latency and eviction-count).

Open questions to ask Sam if time allows:
- Do you prefer async writeups for design work or synchronous pairing?
- Any blockers relying on other teams (infra/observability/legal)? If infra, name the person.

Prep checklist for the meeting (quick):
- Pull up PR #421, Linear RED-812, and the eviction/p95 dashboard link.
- Have calendar options for infra pairing.
- Bring example of a small ticket to reassign if Sam wants bandwidth relief.

Tone notes: be direct but supportive, acknowledge hard work, focus on reducing cognitive load and creating a clear two-week plan.

End of doc.
